no_negative_cases — 4 confirmed in 4 sessions
Cover the unhappy paths: missing or invalid auth (401/403), bad input (400/422), unknown id (404), conflicts (409). A suite of only 2xx tests proves the API accepts good requests, not that it rejects bad ones.
